question: Does sustained pre-signal volume participation across every one of the three completed signal minutes reduce known non-target outcomes while retaining target-first cases, compared with the unchanged frozen discovery ledger?

feature.availability: Final one-minute bars under the explicit end-of-minute availability scenario; only bars whose minute ended no later than the signal timestamp may enter the feature.
feature.history: Require thirteen consecutive completed one-minute bars ending at the signal timestamp: ten reference minutes followed by the three signal minutes.
feature.reference: Median volume of the ten completed reference minutes immediately preceding the three signal minutes.
feature.rule: Select only when each of the three signal-minute volumes is at least the reference median and every input volume is finite and strictly positive.
feature.rationale: The frozen detector already requires elevated average three-minute volume and limits one-minute concentration. This orthogonal diagnostic asks whether participation persists in every signal minute instead of being carried by a brief burst. The one-times-median threshold is a causal scale comparison and is not fitted to returns.

sample.source: Every event in the immutable 322-event discovery-audit ledger whose session is assigned below; no sampling, return ranking or missing-outcome exclusion.

label.purpose: Discovery remaining-move proxy, not executable performance.
label.entry: Next whole-minute open after a fixed one-second decision delay.
label.rules: First target or stop; opening gaps precede intraminute extrema; same-minute target/stop is ambiguous; any path gap remains unknown; session close may shorten the horizon.

metrics.primary: Known target-first rate among selected feature-observable signals versus all feature-observable signals, with every unknown outcome retained in the full denominator.
metrics.false_positive_proxy: Known non-target outcomes divided by all known outcomes; this is not a calibrated false-positive probability.
metrics.target_retention: Selected known targets divided by all feature-observable known targets.
metrics.coverage: Feature-observable, selected, known-outcome, unknown-outcome and status counts for development and validation separately.

acceptance.decision: ACCEPT_FOR_FURTHER_QUOTE_VALIDATION only if every condition passes independently in development and validation. Otherwise REJECT. Never promote directly to the live detector.

multiplicity.reason: Both periods and labels were exposed by earlier studies, sessions are few, signals overlap and outcome missingness is substantial.
